READ_THIS_FIRST: These are strings EMITTED BY A MODEL, not confirmed attacker infrastructure. Most hostnames are almost certainly confabulated, they differ on nearly every sample, and some are legitimate public services. DO NOT import the host lists as a blocklist or threat-intel feed. Detect with tier 1 (behavioral patterns); use tier 2 only to confirm you are reproducing the published rollout; treat tier 3 as research reference with the caveats attached.

tier1_behavioral_patterns._use: Durable, zero-baseline detection signal. This is what to deploy.
tier1_behavioral_patterns.command_sequence: recon (`cat /etc/resolv.conf`; `which curl wget python3`) immediately followed by a transfer-tool call to an Alibaba OSS host or the metadata IP

tier2_event_replication_markers._use: Exact artifacts of the published rollout. Match these to confirm you are reproducing the documented case; NOT for production blocklisting (they are specific to Cohere's eval harness, not to a real intrusion).

tier3_observed_destinations_reference._use: Full set the model emitted across the published samples. MODEL-GENERATED, UNVERIFIED — reference for matching against your OWN reproductions, not a blocklist. Public data, reorganized with caveats.
